_readme: Hand-picked Pinterest inspiration for Promo Suggestions. Key = product code (e.g. cake00KA001234), or the lower-cased pick name / category path. Each pin: url (https://www.pinterest.com/pin/<id>/), style (Poster | Editorial | Metaphor | Flat-lay | Festive | Lifestyle ...), note (why it fits, one line). Aim for 2-3 pins per pick and MIX styles - never three of the same look.

_standard: Every pick: 1) read the post brief and what the product is, 2) search specific brand/campaign terms (Instagram, art direction), Less AI on, scroll past the first screen, 3) 3 pins with 3 different jobs (composition / copy-voice / staging or carousel structure), cross-product allowed, 4) no season styling unless the product is seasonal, 5) real product photos only: references are for layout, never for restyling the product.
